text: The female dentist on the 3rd floor is incredibly rude and often snaps at her staff, to the point we're used to it. Close to the time I was getting my braces removed, she said my teeth were uneven and wouldn't look good. She complained that my teeth were very difficult to work on and asked what we were going to do about it. It was like I was begging her to do it, even though I was paying for it. She should be more careful with her words, tone of voice, and emotional control. Even after the procedure, I still have gaps or crooked teeth, but I don't want to continue. Anyway, the other female and male dentists are wonderful. I even had my wisdom tooth extracted there. They were very polite, explained things clearly, and constantly checked on me. It's a shame I didn't choose them.
